# Shopify Payments reconciliation: June 2026

**Paid out to the bank in June: $572,456.23.** This matches the payouts export.

Card orders placed in June came to $691,562.27. That is **$119,106.04** more than reached the bank in June. The bridge below closes: the unexplained difference is $0.00.

Orders paid outside Shopify Payments came to $82,635.67 in June. That money never goes through Shopify payouts, so it is not in this bridge (see below).

## The bridge

|---|---:|
| Card orders placed in June (Shopify Payments, shipped yet or not) | 691,562.27 |
| − Refunds processed in June | 82,726.47 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;of which on orders from earlier months | 45,616.95 |
| − Card fees | 25,967.07 |

| Failed payout paid again | 0.00 |

| − Still in transit at month end | 117,366.90 |
| **= Paid out for June's card transactions** | **467,444.55** |
| + Paid out in June for transactions before the transactions export starts | 105,011.68 |
| **= Paid out to the bank in June** | **572,456.23** |

In plain terms, June's missing card sales went to four places:

- **Refunds** of $82,726.47. Of that, $45,616.95 was on orders from earlier months and $37,109.52 was on June orders.
- **Card fees** of $25,967.07.
- **Disputes**: the net cost was $1,452.93. No disputes were won back and no dispute fees were returned in June.
- **Money still in transit on 30 June**: $117,366.90. This money is not lost. It is covered in the next section.

In the other direction, $105,011.68 of the June 1–4 payouts came from May transactions. The transactions export starts on 1 June, so those May transactions are not in it. That amount goes in the bank's favour.

No reserve was held or released, and there were no Shopify adjustments in June.

## Failed payout on 30 June

| Payout date | Total (USD) |
|---|---:|
| 2026-06-30 | 18,132.40 |

The payout of 30 June **failed**, so it did not reach the bank in June. Its orders are counted in "Still in transit at month end". The transactions export shows it was paid again in the payout of 7 July (Retried Amount). Please check that the 7 July bank deposit includes it. You may also want to check that the bank details on Shopify Payments are correct, because a payout failed. The bank figure above was checked against the payouts export, payout by payout and matches it.
